name: Promotion as a conjunction over two causally independent orders
form: promote(k) <-> ev(k) >= bar  AND  exists a: grants(a,k)
stage_reason: bar is undefined. Three incompatible candidates exist in the corpus (ES-006.1 n>=2, P-4's five-point scale, CAP-001). F1->F2 requires every defining condition closed.

objects: grants: Act x Knowledge -> Bool (append-only log)

tests_run.degenerate_bar_0: REDUCES to governance alone — CONTRADICTS 'requires BOTH'
tests_run.degenerate_bar_inf: promote = FALSE for all k — PREDICTS the observed 0 traversals (see EM-0002)
tests_run.decidability: grants decidable over an act log; ev>=bar UNDECIDABLE until bar is defined

falsifiable_as: MATHEMATICAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE — exhibit a promotion that occurred with only one conjunct satisfied.

name: Authority as a product — and a schema that cannot hold it
form: authority = P x S,  |P|=2 (immutable),  |S|=3 (act-changed),  |P x S| = 6
stage_reason: Whether the correct algebra is a product, a lattice or two independent fields is open (PM-1, unanswered). But the CARDINALITY result below is F2-grade and stands independently.

tests_run.cardinality: ⛔ FAIL — 6 product states required, one 5-valued field supplied. The field admits EITHER a P value OR an S value, never both.
tests_run.boundary_case: F0018's own worked example ('derived in provenance AND authoritative in standing') is NOT REPRESENTABLE in the schema it analyses
tests_run.existence: the product is well-defined; its storage is not

falsifiable_as: LOGICAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE — one document carrying both a P and an S value in the authority field.

name: Check-before-admit as a total function
stage_reason: Five instances, all three outcomes observed, but the function's decision procedure is not stated by any file — the corpus performs it without naming it.

elements.domain: proposed concept X x model M

tests_run.totality: 5 of 5 proposals classified — no unhandled case in the window
tests_run.closure: outputs are decisions about M, not new X — the operation does not generate work for itself
tests_run.generalization: SUBSUMES T-0017's splitting rule as the SPLITS_M case

falsifiable_as: CORPUS_FALSIFIER — a proposal admitted without the check, or an outcome outside the three.

name: Append-only record with supersession edges
form: record' = record + {new} + {supersedes: new -> old};  ⛔ never  record' = record \ {old} + {new}
stage_reason: Monotonicity holds across 4 observed corrections with 1 diagnostic exception; the formal ordering relation on supersession is not yet stated.

tests_run.counterexample: IFR-0010 — F0019's annotation was itself rewritten; that first form is the window's ONLY unrecoverable text. ⭐ The single violation produced the single loss.
tests_run.invariance: the falsified body of F0020 is byte-preserved under its own falsification banner

falsifiable_as: CORPUS_FALSIFIER — a second destructive correction, or a preserved original after a destructive one.

name: Monotone counter as a logical clock
form: c: Event -> N, strictly increasing; induces a total order where dates induce none
stage_reason: Global monotonicity unverified (RO-0010). ⭐ Its IMPORTANCE is now measured: 45% of event pairs in this window cannot be ordered by date at all.

tests_run.measured_necessity: 302 of 666 event pairs (45%) share a date — the counter is the only finer signal available
tests_run.uniqueness: UNTESTED — if two tracks maintain separate counters the induced order is invalid

falsifiable_as: CORPUS_FALSIFIER — a repeated or decreasing counter value anywhere in the corpus.

name: Recursive containment
form: KnowledgeSpace contains KnowledgeSpace*; deployment is the nested case
stage_reason: Single instance; depth, termination and identity-under-nesting all unexamined.
falsifiable_as: ARCHITECTURAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE — a deployment that is not a Knowledge Space.
